visitor_mode: Persuade (an AI video and character studio, Cineyx); inferred from 'AI VIDEO & CHARACTER STUDIO' and 'Start for free'. The product's output is pictures, so generated sample output is the product's own material.
overall_reason: The 'What you can actually create' cards show the studio's own output (before-and-after restorations, one character in six styles, a virtual photoshoot grid), but two feature cards use glow-kit composites instead of the product: floating glass screens joined by a lightning bolt (#6) and greeting cards on a neon pedestal (#8).

score.reason: T-MATERIAL-SOURCE passes on the restoration and style samples, but T-AI-LOOK and T-STAND-IN fail on the screenwriter and cards-and-banners composites and T-TREATMENT fails on repeated cyan and amber blur orbs (IMG-001, IMG-005, IMG-012).

findings.where: 'Restore and enhance old photos' grid, img ai-screenwriter-viral-content.jpg and cards-and-banners.png (366 by 205px at y 1600), 1440 (contact sheet #6 and #8; tiles/1440-01.png)
findings.evidence: Picture #6 shows two dark glass app panels floating among tilted document icons, joined by a cyan lightning bolt. Picture #8 shows a 'Happy Birthday' card with a cartoon cat, a 'Retro Style' banner and a social-media card on a glowing blue pedestal with floating bubbles. Neither is a capture of the screenwriter or the design tool.
findings.before: Glow-kit composite scenes for the screenwriter and the design tool.
findings.after: A 2x capture of the AI Screenwriter's script view with a real prompt and output, and three real designs from the design tool laid flat.
findings.why: The other cards prove the studio by showing its output; these two show a mood of 'AI' instead.

findings.where: 'Restore and enhance old photos' grid, ai-screenwriter-viral-content.jpg, 1440 (contact sheet #6)
findings.evidence: The screenwriter picture redraws two app windows with unreadable placeholder lines, floating at an angle in a cyan haze; alt reads 'AI Screenwriter and Brainstorm Room turning an idea into a r...'. The product exists behind 'Open Cinematic Studio'.
findings.before: A redrawn, unreadable rendering of the product's own screens.
findings.after: A capture of the Brainstorm Room at the size shown, with readable text.
findings.why: A drawn stand-in for a product that exists hides what the visitor would get.

findings.where: blurred cyan and amber shapes behind the feature sections, div.absolute (288px and 240px, y 2381 to 4761), 1440 (contact sheet #3, #4, #9, #10)
findings.evidence: The table lists four heavy-blur shapes in rgba(18, 192, 226) and rgba(246, 158, 35), and the sweep records seven gradient hits ('gradient hue span 149°: #12c0e2, #f69e23') and six glow hits (SLP-007, SLP-008).
findings.before: Cyan and amber blur orbs behind section cards.
findings.after: Flat dark grounds; let the sample output carry the colour.
findings.why: Two-colour glow orbs are the kit's default texture and compete with the output pictures.

findings.where: 'Start for free' thumbnail marquee, img.h-[90px].w-[160px] (30 thumbnails at y 5507 to 5667), 1440 (contact sheet #2)
findings.evidence: Ten cover files repeat three times across three rows at 160 by 90px under a 0.85 black gradient scrim; cover-10.jpg is a portrait file (768 by 1376px) cropped into a landscape slot.
findings.before: Thirty dimmed thumbnails behind the closing CTA.
findings.after: Fewer thumbnails shown larger (one row at 320 by 180px) without the 85% scrim, each in its own ratio slot.
findings.why: At 160px under an 85% scrim no thumbnail can be read; the marquee is texture rather than proof.

strengths: The restoration cards show the studio's actual output in before-and-after pairs (old-photo-montargis, restore-before and restore-after), labelled BEFORE and AFTER, with files at 5 to 6x their shown width.
The character-styles grid shows one character in six labelled styles, which is the product's own claim pictured.
